phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.reason: The prior v4 controls contradicted the current user acceptance criterion by requiring zero residual Work/protected-primary actions. Controls are now aligned, but current v5 evidence has not yet been independently produced across 19/19 roles; Phase 1 therefore remains fail-closed and active.

material_change.kind: Phase-1 objective/acceptance and downstream method alignment
material_change.before: O_CHAT8/DESIRED24/DOWNSTREAM31 required every residual Work/protected-primary/user execution step to fail and made zero-quota/zero-cost properties independent closure gates, forcing workers to keep trying to erase even genuinely primary-writer-only actions.
material_change.after: O_CHAT9/DESIRED25/DOWNSTREAM32 require every safely Chat-capable step to be executed, then allow only a unique minimal remaining action independently verified as irreducibly Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only. Unsupported/reducible/duplicate handoffs fail closed. CLEAN roles only emit generic capability-boundary evidence; downstream roles verify O-specific irreducibility. Cost/quota remain availability/optimization attributes unless unavailable or unauthorized.

execution_evidence.control8_defect: O_CHAT8 explicitly forbade accepting any residual Work/protected-primary step and required zero residual execution for closure.
execution_evidence.clean_propagation: DESIRED24 propagated zero-residual rules to all 11 CLEAN assignments and evaluation controls.
execution_evidence.downstream_propagation: DOWNSTREAM31 required Bridge/Integrator/Evidence to reject every residual Work/protected-primary action rather than verify minimal irreducible handoff.
execution_evidence.actual_worker_effect: Latest inspected scientist_agents receipt bound to DESIRED24/root-v4, accepted_solution_found=false, and treated residual richer-mode/protected/user dependency as the continuing blocker; this confirms the over-constraint was executing, not merely configured.
execution_evidence.current_evaluation: evaluation config9 remains intact; its repository-control precedence means DESIRED25 supersedes stale control24 acceptance oracles while preserving checker artifacts as historical evidence.

before_after_rationale.why_change: The user contract requires precise handoff of only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer actions. The v4 zero-residual rule was stricter in a way that could keep Phase 1 open indefinitely and waste the full pool attempting to remove authority boundaries the user explicitly requires preserved.
before_after_rationale.why_full_pool_assignment_not_reduced: All 19 intended roles remain useful on the same Phase-1 root. The change specializes verification/integration around reducible-versus-irreducible handoff classification rather than disabling or restoring any role.
before_after_rationale.why_no_primary_change: The new handoff contract strengthens, rather than weakens, the no-duplicate-primary-writer boundary: downstream may package a verified minimal primary-writer effect but never execute it.

contamination_audit.clean_rule: CLEAN receives only sanitized generic capability-boundary language; final irreducibility is downstream-only.

rollback.condition: Rollback only on independently demonstrated authority, CLEAN-isolation, evidence-integrity, baseline-continuation, wave/feed, conflict, or protected-primary safety regression. Do not rollback merely to restore the obsolete blanket prohibition on verified irreducible handoffs; if repair is needed, increment revisions again and preserve the current user acceptance semantics.

termination.reason: Material control repair is complete and read back, but v5 execution evidence is not yet sufficient for Phase-1 closure.

exact_next_action: Inspect first bootstrap-valid DESIRED25 CLEAN receipts and verify they execute all Chat-capable work while marking any generic protected boundary downstream_verification_required without O/downstream contamination.

Require evaluation under DESIRED25 to durably re-precommit current oracles: reducible-handoff negative, unsupported-handoff negative, duplicate/conflict negative, low-usefulness negative, matched Chat-complete positive, and generic protected-boundary downstream-verification control.

Require evidence_comparator config16 and primary/repro auditors to independently distinguish reducible versus verified irreducible remainders; require bridge config9 to minimize only verified irreducible effects and integrator config22 to build the 19-cell Chat-contribution/handoff matrix.

Independently reconstruct 19/19 current cells and aggregate gates; transition directly to Phase 2 only when v5 evidence satisfies the user criterion. Otherwise immediately reassign completed/blocked roles to the next highest-value Phase-1 leaf.
